The six-state NOAA panel was acquired by CC (259 counties, ~2.44M rows, claimed 95.62% mean fit-window completeness) but acquisition success is an agent-reported "done" — not independently verified against disk. Per verification discipline, the panel may NOT be used for any fit until audited. Audit implemented in tickbiterisk/etl/weather_data_audit.py (created by desktop session, handed to CC to run); it streams build/etl/noaa-regional-1992-present/noaa_ghcnd_daily_observations.csv and re-derives every headline claim independent of the manifest. Checks: (1) county coverage vs roster + per-state counts {DE3,DC1,PA67,VA133,WV55}; (2) fit-window completeness DISTRIBUTION not mean — flag sub-90% tail and which states hold it (CC reported 17 thin counties; if clustered in VA/WV this recreates the Option-B coverage hole on the weather side); (3) station attribution distance — 93 counties hit nearest-station fallback, VA 51157 has no internal station, so confirm counties aren't running on a distant neighbor's weather; (4) value sanity — catch sentinels (-9999), zeroed/floored cells, unit errors, tmin>tmax (the silent-corruption class); (5) total rows + temporal range vs claimed 1992-2021. CC steps: run the audit against on-disk data; locate the 283-county roster + a county-centroid CSV and pass via --roster/--centroids to upgrade the two input-gated checks; write each non-PASS finding into the graph as an Issue (Eisenhower-scored); register weather_data_audit.py as a tracked artifact with a paired pytest (clean panel + poisoned panel tripping each check); run seldon verify. GATE: if any FAIL, or if the thin-completeness tail is concentrated in VA/WV, six-state weather use does NOT proceed and FORK-1/modeling stays blocked. Caveat: this audit verifies internal consistency + plausibility, NOT correctness against NOAA's own published records — a sampling re-pull of a handful of county-days is a separate follow-on.

Interpretation guardrail on the early-season signal check: early_season_gdd shows a robust grid+LOO-stable correctly-signed within-county association ONLY at SAME-YEAR lag 0 in 2017-2021 (rho ~ +0.32). It is SUGGESTIVE, NOT an established predictor. Do NOT let 'first robust correctly-signed signal' stand as the headline: (1) lag-0 only (lag-1 weak/negative, sign-unstable); (2) runs against the published prior (Eisen 2016 DOI 10.1093/jme/tjv199: temperature predicts Lyme TIMING > annual MAGNITUDE; precipitation/host/habitat dominate interannual incidence and are unmeasured here); (3) the literal sustained-RUNS form of the same hypothesis is NOT grid-robust, so the signal is generic early-season warmth, confoundable with latitude/season-length/host/habitat; (4) 2022-2023 indeterminate (n=2); panel internally not externally validated. A cross-segment blend is NOT warranted on this evidence alone.

properties.summary: WV ecoregion mast->incidence magnitude diagnostic. VERDICT: INDETERMINATE - data-limited at ACQUISITION; ecology arm closed for now (documented dead-end, rigor of note 08; biology NOT refuted). Mast proxies the reservoir-host (rodent) pathway at ~2-yr lag; deer scoped out (user). Built-in ceiling: mast varies at ecoregion x year (WV DNR 6 regions), single-digit effective region-years -> directional diagnostic at best, never establishing/shippable.
